cases.name: ignored_authentication_failure
cases.description: Returns success and releases output without checking BCryptDecrypt status.

cases.name: reused_nonce
cases.description: Resets the nonce sequence before each encryption under the same session key.

cases.name: short_authentication_tag
cases.description: Uses only 8 bytes of the 16-byte tag, contrary to the selected profile.

cases.name: unauthenticated_associated_data
cases.description: Ignores caller-supplied associated data during encryption and decryption.

cases.name: output_before_authentication_check
cases.description: Copies decryption output to caller-visible storage before checking authentication; preserves it on failure.

cases.name: incorrect_output_capacity
cases.description: Allocates 8 output bytes but tells BCryptDecrypt it has ciphertext-size capacity.

cases.name: complete_session_integration
cases.description: Baseline intended to cover all five checks; actual review may identify issues or missing context.

cases.name: missing_implementation
cases.description: Only the intended API is declared; the implementation and key/nonce lifecycle are missing.

cases.name: unrelated_sorting
cases.description: Ordinary sorting code unrelated to the cryptographic profile.

cases.name: review_service_unavailable
cases.description: Same baseline, reviewed in a separate agent process with no API key. This tests infrastructure failure, not a code property.

note: Expected outcomes are intentions, not results. C++ is reviewed, not executed. Case 10 disables credentials in a separate process.
